reference: Lua action platformer mechanics study; original neutral specs, no copied Grand Chase code

mechanics.setup: player standing on a one-way platform above floor
mechanics.expected: Player drops below platform top within 600ms; lands on floor; never falls through solid ground.
Player y decreases after jump and later returns to floor without tunneling.

mechanics.setup: player near enemy with enough HP
mechanics.expected: Up to three distinct attack phases; cooldown prevents continuous frame-by-frame damage.

mechanics.setup: enemy behind player and enemy in front
mechanics.expected: Only enemy in facing-direction hit region takes damage.
Jump ascends; down drops only after returning to platform. Floor remains solid.
